close_reason: Aligned all public Error types to Clone+Debug+PartialEq+Eq baseline. pkix-revocation-http::FetchError documented as exception (Box<dyn Error> in Transport variant prevents Clone/PartialEq). pkix-path-builder retains Hash (was already there). pkix-lint::DeviationAddError already had the baseline. Workspace builds; full test suite passes (no regressions).
description:
Pass 2 idiom finding under epic PKIX-qwzx.

The 8 public `Error` types across the workspace have inconsistent derive sets:

| Crate | Error type | Derives |
|-------|------------|---------|
| `pkix-path` | `Error` | `Clone, Debug` |
| `pkix-revocation` | `Error` | `Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq` |
| `pkix-path-builder` | `Error` | `Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash` |
| `pkix-chain` | `Error` | `Debug` |
| `pkix-chain-simple` | `Error` | `Debug` |
| `pkix-ac` | `Error` | `Debug` |
| `pkix-ct` | `Error` | `Debug` |
| `pkix-revocation-http` | `FetchError` | `Debug` |
| `pkix-lint::deviation` | `DeviationAddError` | `Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq` |

The Rust idiomatic baseline for an error type is `Clone + Debug + PartialEq + Eq` so callers can:
- store errors in result-aggregating containers (`Vec<Error>`, snapshot tests)
- compare errors in unit tests (`assert_eq!(result.unwrap_err(), Error::X)`)
- propagate errors through layers without `Box<dyn>` workarounds

Locations:
- `pkix-path/src/lib.rs:88-89`  
- `pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs:59-61`  
- `pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:111-113`  
- `pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:54-55`  
- `pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs:268-270`  
- `pkix-ac/src/lib.rs:69-71`  
- `pkix-ct/src/lib.rs:55-57`  
- `pkix-revocation-http/src/lib.rs:51-53`

Constraint: `pkix-path::Error` contains `Der(DerError)` where `DerError(der::Error)` is not `PartialEq` (deliberately, but `pkix-revocation::DerError` IS — see separate finding). To add `PartialEq, Eq` to `pkix-path::Error`, `pkix-path::DerError` would also need them. `pkix-chain::Error` and `pkix-chain-simple::Error` wrap typed inner errors; `Clone` is feasible if the inner errors are.

Fix: pick a workspace-wide minimum (suggest `Clone + Debug + PartialEq + Eq`) and reconcile all error types to it, with documented exceptions where a contained foreign type prevents one of the derives.
title: (IDIOM) P3: inconsistent Error derives across 8 Error types (Clone/PartialEq/Eq/Hash form varying subset)
